region.name: Garden of the Gods, Shawnee National Forest, Illinois (Earth analog)
region.frame: x = east (m), z = south (m), origin at region centre; row 0 = north edge

processing: Region bounds transformed into each source CRS; only the window is read (HTTP range requests).
USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM resampled (cubic) onto a 401 x 401, 5 m local transverse-Mercator grid: the planner's terrain.
NASADEM (Space Shuttle radar, reprocessed by NASA JPL) resampled the same way and compared with 3DEP.
NAIP aerial photograph (2023-08-18) resampled (bilinear) to 4096 x 4096 over the 2 km square, 0.49 m per pixel. Colours are as photographed.
